title: Click-Clack Curio Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled in a twilight-blue grotto of sunken brass astrolabes and softly glowing kelp, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its days briskly tapping bits of sea glass and smooth pebbles into intricate, ever-shifting mosaics. Whenever a visitor leans close, its skin ripples with warm amber constellations as it eagerly shuffles its collection into a brand-new riddle.
